entities.summary: Amiga is a popular music record label in Germany. Once an organ of the East German state-owned music publisher VEB Deutsche Schallplatten, Amiga became a label of the Bertelsmann Music Group in 1994. Amiga is a record label, established in 1947. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
